text:
Aisha: Quick sync — proposing a concrete plan for calibration dataset selection + prompt-set curation for the upcoming mixed-quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). Goal: make deltas interpretable across deployment profiles (low-latency small batches vs throughput batched).
Marco: sounds good. can you outline the sampling heuristics you're thinking?
Aisha: high-level: 1) stratify by domain (docs, code, dialogue, instructions, math) 2) stratify by token length buckets (<=32, 33-128, 129-512, >512) 3) add a long-tail edge-case bucket (OCR noise, garbled html, non-latin) 4) holdouts per model family and a common anchor set for cross-quant comparison.
Priya: for anchors, do we want fixed paraphrase variants? e.g., same semantic intent but 3 temperatures / style tweaks so we can track sensitivity to prompt style?
Aisha: yes — anchor spec: 2k root prompts x 3 style variants (formal, terse, verbose) => 6k anchor evals. Probes: 1k domain-heavy edgecases (split 50/50 auto vs human-curated). Holdouts: 500 unseen prompts per domain for final regression tests.
Marco: ok for sizes. how about negative controls / sanity checks? we should include known failure cases and adversarial edits.
Aisha: add 200 negative-control dialogs and 200 adversarial edits (typos, injected tokens) per format. Also add alignment/regression test set for hallucination: 300 fact-check items.
Kevin: for quant run profiles: I'll run GPTQ/AWQ conversions on a sample of 100 anchor prompts first, profile token-latency and FFLOPS. Which precision config matrix do you want?
Aisha: matrix: FP16 baseline, FP8 (per-channel), INT8 symmetric, GPTQ-8 + AWQ-8 variants. Record: accuracy (exact-match/ROUGE/BLEU where appropriate), model confidence calibration (ECE), and latency P50/P95 under these two deployment profiles: 1) latency-first (batch=1, max-concurrency 8) 2) throughput-first (batch=32, concurrency 64).
Priya: for prompt variants — I'll create a small generator script to emit paraphrases + formality shifts. Draft snippet: 
```python
# lightweight template-based paraphraser
templates = ["{q}", "In short: {q}", "Can you explain: {q}?"]
def emit_variants(q):
    return [t.format(q=q) for t in templates]
```
Marco: nice. I'll add token-length-preserving edits for bucket testing (insert/remove punctuation, code formatting markers).
Aisha: metadata we need for each prompt: domain, length_bucket, source_origin (web/corp/annotator), anchor_id (if applicable), human_curated (bool), adversarial_tag (enum). Keep as CSV + JSONL for runs.
Kevin: will instrument per-token timing and peak memory. also will dump KV-cache stats for long-context runs.
eval-bot: auto-report — ran a quick smoke on 100 anchors with GPTQ-8 on staging: avg delta vs fp16: -1.8% EM, P95 latency 38ms (batch=1). Full matrix queued.
Aisha: great — next steps: Priya draft prompt generator and initial domain taxonomy by EOD tomorrow, Marco produce token-length edit harness, Kevin queue conversion on 4 GPUs, I'll assemble the anchor list and push to /evals/curation/v2. Action items in-thread pls. :thumbsup:
Marco: on it.
Priya: starting now.
Kevin: queued.
Aisha: thanks — we'll sync Friday for first bakeoff readout.
